text:
A: Hiya! Hello, can you hear me? Sorry, I always think I'm on mute.
B: Yeah, hi, I can hear you.
A: Oh, brilliant. I'm Donna, I'm in Thornton Heath, Croydon. You're the one with the ginger cat, aren't you? I saw him in your picture, I loved him.
B: Ha, yeah, that's Biscuit. I'm Kerry, I'm in Stowmarket. Erm, I loved your nails, to be fair.
A: Aw, thank you! I only had them done Saturday. They won't last, I'm a care assistant, so they take a battering, you know what I mean. Twelve-hour shifts, hoisting and that.
B: Gosh, twelve hours. I'm knackered after a morning on the phones.
A: What do you do then?
B: Office admin, for a plumbing firm. Booking boiler services mostly.
A: Oh, you must get some right moaners. I tell you, the families at my place, some of them, they ring up like you was the one that made their mum poorly. But mostly they're lovely, a lot of them ask for me by name, which is nice.
B: That's nice. My mum's having her knee looked at at the moment, so I've been thinking about all that sort of thing.
A: Oh, bless her. Is she alright?
B: Yeah, she's alright, she's just slowing down a bit. She does the school pick-ups for me, so.
A: That's how it starts though, isn't it, and you're like, hang on. My mum's seventy-eight. I'm round there all the time, checking, because I see what happens at work, you know?
B: Yeah. You worry, don't you.
A: All the time. How many kids have you got?
B: Two. Ellie's twelve and Josh is nine. Ellie's on at me for TikTok.
A: Oh, don't! My granddaughter's not even one and I'm already thinking about that. I'm a nan, did I say? Shanice's baby. That's her photo on my windowsill.
B: Oh, I saw that, she's gorgeous.
A: She's my world, honestly. Sorry, I'm going on. What d'you watch? You look like a Love Island girl, I'm not gonna lie.
B: Ha, yeah, guilty. And Married at First Sight.
A: Yes! Married at First Sight, the Australian one, the dinner parties? I'm screaming at the telly. My Clive just goes upstairs.
B: Darren's the same. He says he hates it, then he's asking what happened.
A: They all do that! Erm, sorry, what was I, oh, did you speak to Julie? She's the manager one.
B: Yeah, she was nice. She goes to Tenerife same as us.
